experimentalOverlay.overallTrajectoryDiagnosis: ACTIVE DISSOLUTION DETECTED: 1 test point(s) (Test Point #1) are located in the active acid corrosion domain with rapid uniform metal loss driven by cathodic depolarization.

engineeringMitigations: Apply Cathodic Protection (CP) to depress potential below immunity boundary (E < 0.17 V vs SHE).
Add anodic passivation inhibitors (e.g. chromates, nitrites, molybdates) or neutralizers to shift pH > 7.0.
points.mechanismDetails: In presence of dissolved oxygen (ORR), Cu spontaneously dissolves into cupric Cu²⁺ ions.
